$comment: Customer AWS accounts that receive a mirror of each release's arm64 Pi runtime image (THINK-616).
AgentCore Runtime is arm64-only and the customer deployment runner resolves the runtime image from
the CUSTOMER ECR under the tag '<releaseVersion>-pi-arm64' (see runner.py: reconcile of the Pi runtime).
The release workflow's mirror-customer-images job reads this file into a job matrix, so adding a new
enterprise account here is the only change needed for it to inherit the behavior.
The repo variable RELEASE_MIRROR_TARGETS, when set, overrides this file with the same JSON shape.
Account IDs are not secrets; no credentials belong in this file.
